cases.prompt: Which companies raised funding in September 2025? Show all matching rounds.
cases.text:
8 funding rounds recorded in Locus with announcement dates from September 1 to September 30, 2025. This is the complete matching set.

* Vercel: September 30, Series F, $300M. [Source](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20250930898216/en/)
* Modal: September 29, Series B, $87M. [Source](https://modal.com/blog/announcing-our-series-b)
* Cohere: September 24, Growth, $100M. [Source](https://cohere.com/blog/september-2025-funding-round)
* Groq: September 17, Growth, $750M. [Source](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/groq-raises-750-million-as-inference-demand-surges-302558961.html)
* Mistral AI: September 9, Series C, $2B. [Source](https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-ai-raises-1-7-b-to-accelerate-technological-progress-with-ai/)
* Baseten: September 5, Series D, $150M. [Source](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20250905680113/en/Baseten-Secures-%24150M-Series-D-as-the-Premier-Inference-Platform-for-AIs-App-Layer)
* Exa: September 3, Series B, $85M. [Source](https://exa.ai/blog/announcing-series-b)
* Anthropic: September 2, Series F, $13B. [Source](https://www.anthropic.com/news/anthropic-raises-series-f-at-usd183b-post-money-valuation)

Amounts are individual round amounts, not company total funding.
